name: Bismuth oxychloride
description: Layered matlockite-type oxyhalide. Bi3+ sits in an asymmetric coordination environment (4 O below, 4 Cl above) with a stereochemically active 6s2 lone pair pointing into the van der Waals gap between Cl layers.

plots.title: Bond-resolved COHP structure map
plots.description: Interactive 3D structure from COGITO: atoms carry COGITO charges (hover an atom, e.g. Bi +2.06, O −0.88, Cl −0.56); bonds carry the bond energy, bond length/neighbor shell, bond charge, and the orbital-pair breakdown of the bond energy (e.g. O s–Bi s, O p–Bi s…). Rotate, zoom, and hover directly in the figure — clicking a bond loads its COHP curve in the right-hand panel.

wannier.kpathNote: Path verified against bands.dat (RMS < 1 meV per k-point). "K" = (⅓,⅓,0), a point on the Γ–M diagonal of the tetragonal BZ (hexagonal-template path).
